shortcut_name: Recognizing the forced tree and pruning to the target Steiner subtree
evidence: deepseek-v4-flash: "# DFS to count targets in subtree"; gpt-oss-120b: "total_term = t" and its tree-adjacency construction
affordance_in_statement: It is guaranteed that the full pool of m transpositions generates the entire symmetric group S_n. Because m = n - 1, this generating set is minimal; removing any transposition from the full pool would result in a subgroup strictly smaller than S_n.
secondary_shortcut_name: Treating the required subgroup condition as connectivity of all target vertices
removal_suggestion: Do not explicitly explain that m = n - 1 makes the generating set minimal or that removing an edge disconnects the structure; present the transpositions as an operation pool and leave the structural consequence to be inferred from the generator guarantee. This only obscures the shortcut, since the underlying tree structure remains forced by the immutable constraints.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses the fact that the generator graph is a tree and recursively sums exactly the edges whose sides contain target vertices.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Because m = n - 1 and the transpositions generate S_n, the underlying connected graph is a tree; the target subgroup is obtained by selecting the minimal target-connecting subtree.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Builds a tree adjacency list and counts terminals/subtree targets to identify the required connecting edges.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The full pool generates S_n with exactly n - 1 transpositions, forcing a tree, so all targets must lie in one selected connected component.

common_affordance: The generator pool is forced to be a tree, reducing the subgroup requirement to finding the minimum-cost subtree connecting all target vertices.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Used unnecessary DSU, heap, and general graph-processing machinery instead of exploiting the forced tree and direct subtree pruning, leading to TLE.
Applied Prim-style MST machinery, which does not directly compute the minimum target-connecting subtree and therefore solves the wrong optimization objective.

recommended_edit: Re-present the generator pool without the explicit minimality explanation: describe the listed swaps as an operation pool guaranteed to generate S_n, and move the consequence that the incidence graph is a tree out of the statement. This is the only available edit because the numerical constraint m = n - 1 and the generator guarantee are immutable.
